admins.description: List of Gitolite admin usernames. Admins have full read/write/ssh access to all repositories, including the gitolite-admin repo.

description.description: Optional human-readable description of the repository.

admins.description: List of usernames with read-write-plus (RW+) access to this repo (e.g., team leads).

writers.description: List of usernames with read-write (RW) access (e.g., developers).

readers.description: List of usernames with read-only (R) access (e.g., CI accounts, reviewers).

repositories.description: List of repositories to create/secure. Each entry defines a repo name and optional access groups.

name.description: Name of the source repository to mirror.

target.description: Target remote URL for mirroring (e.g., 'git@backup-server:repo.git' or 'https://gitlab.com/org/repo.git').

mirrors.description: List of repositories to mirror using Gitolite’s mirroring feature. Requires Gitolite v3.6+ and the 'mirror' plugin enabled.

name.description: Repository name to which custom hook config applies.

config.description: Key–value pairs for Gitolite config overrides (e.g., {'hook.post-receive': 'notify-slack'}).

hooks.description: List of repositories requiring custom Gitolite config (e.g., hooks, branch restrictions).
